admission.justification: Named reader and landing regression cases distinguish exact complete product-version substitutions from other changed bytes or distinguishable dependency tokens, preventing false document debt on a release bump without claiming semantic package ownership.

applicability: Whole-file links in dependent records when state is derived by a knowledge read or a landing.
conditions: The whole-file blobs differ, and exact confirmation and selected-tree metadata provide the old and new product version identities.
Every token is unchanged or is the exact old-to-new complete product version substitution with its existing empty, v or V prefix; all intervening and trailing bytes stay identical.
exclusions: Anchor-content and record-revision links retain their own movement predicates.
Missing or unreadable exact version provenance, unreadable blobs and non-UTF8 blobs excuse no changed whole-file blob.
This text comparison cannot establish semantic package ownership when a dependency has the same complete old/new token pair as the product; the accompanying open weakness records that limit.

statement: A file link stays current only when every changed complete version token is the product's exact old-to-new version substitution, with any leading v preserved, and all other bytes stay unchanged.
